name: Laundry Tower Cabinet

materials.carcass: 1.9 cm moisture-resistant melamine board with 2.8 cm reinforced structural dryer shelf

hardware.style: Push-to-open, 110-degree soft-close concealed hinges, soft-close concealed undermount drawer slides

brief:
LAUNDRY TOWER CABINET SPECIFICATION

1. ENVELOPE & FOOTPRINT
- Overall Dimensions: 70 cm (Width) x 70 cm (Depth) x 240 cm (Height)
- Usable Internal Depth: 67 cm
- Plinth: 7 cm height, recessed 2 cm

2. MATERIALS & CONSTRUCTION
- Primary Carcass: 1.9 cm moisture-resistant melamine/lacquered board
- Reinforced Structural Shelf (Dryer Support): 2.8 cm load-bearing panel
- Back Panel: Open back at washing machine and dryer niches for plumbing, venting, and power; 0.8 cm groove-set backboard behind drawer and top cupboard bays

3. HARDWARE & FIT-OUT
- Upper Cupboard: 2 side-hung, side-by-side doors with 110-degree soft-close concealed hinges, push-to-open mechanism
- Drawer: Full-extension concealed undermount slides, soft-close, push-to-open

4. VERTICAL STACK & CLEARANCES (Bottom to Top)
- 0.0 to 7.0 cm: Recessed plinth base (7 cm H)
- 7.0 to 8.9 cm: Base shelf (1.9 cm thickness)
- 8.9 to 94.9 cm: Washing machine niche (66.2 cm clear W x 67 cm clear D x 86 cm clear H)
- 94.9 to 96.8 cm: Intermediate divider shelf (1.9 cm thickness)
- 96.8 to 112.8 cm: Utility/small items drawer (16 cm front H x 66.2 cm W)
- 112.8 to 115.6 cm: Reinforced structural dryer shelf (2.8 cm thickness)
- 115.6 to 201.6 cm: Tumble dryer niche (66.2 cm clear W x 67 cm clear D x 86 cm clear H)
- 201.6 to 203.5 cm: Cupboard bottom shelf (1.9 cm thickness)
- 203.5 to 238.1 cm: Upper storage cupboard (66.2 cm clear W x 67 cm clear D x 34.6 cm clear H) enclosed by 2 side-by-side swing doors (approx. 34.6 cm W x 38 cm H each)
- 238.1 to 240.0 cm: Top structural panel (1.9 cm thickness)
render_notes: Single-bay vertical laundry column. Bottom compartment accommodates washing machine, followed by a middle utility drawer, tumble dryer compartment above on reinforced shelf, and top storage cabinet with two side-by-side push-to-open doors.
